cause: The swing sole does not track the lift. Weight is already on the stance foot (stance fraction 0.89–1.00, swing GRF mean 0–2.8 N). The knee q̈ cap does not bind: the planned excursion is 0.09–0.16 rad and 40 rad/s² can reach about 0.9 rad in the 0.216 s window; inverse |q̈| stays inside the cap. Ctrl is never outside ±2.09. Trunk drop from the stand stays under 6.3 mm. ctrl = q + (tau_ff + kv·ω + 1.0·(q_ref−q)) / kp with kp 45, so the command sits 12–27 mrad off the measured knee while the lift reference is 60–140 mrad away. At armature 0.01, tau_ff cancels the 1 Nm/rad spring (net about 0) and the measured knee Δq is opposite the plan. At 0.025 the armature term leaves a net near 0.3 Nm and the knee moves only part of the planned Δq. On three windows the reference itself pitches the sole, so the lowest corner stays near 0 mm while the box bottom rises about 6–8 mm. The three contact, corner, and force tests never disagree. One window is airborne on every tick and still peaks at 4.98 mm with 2.45 mm of airborne forward travel. Step fraction is 0. Both rows are latency-test-first. Prefer FAIL. No CLEAR.
